class.name: NNSTAllOfGuard
class.brief_description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all of the [member guards] are satisfied.
class.description: This guard returns [code]true[/code] only if all of the [member guards] are satisfied. Use it to require multiple conditions to hold at the same time. An empty [member guards] array returns [code]true[/code]. Any [code]null[/code] entries in [member guards] are skipped, so an array containing only [code]null[/code] entries also returns [code]true[/code]. It reports the bitwise OR of the trigger types of all non-null entries in [member guards] from [method NNSTGuard.get_supported_trigger_types].

method.name: is_satisfied
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all non-null entries in [member guards] are satisfied (including when [member guards] is empty or contains only [code]null[/code] entries), [code]false[/code] otherwise.

members.member: An array of guards to be evaluated.
